value.description: The selected date and/or time value in ISO 8601 format. If not yet set, initialize with an empty string.

enableDate.description: If true, allows the user to select a date.

enableTime.description: If true, allows the user to select a time.

min.description: The minimum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format. Use an ISO 8601 `date` when only date selection is enabled, a `time` when only time selection is enabled, or a `date-time` when date and time are both enabled. The boundary is inclusive and should not be later than `max`.

max.description: The maximum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format. Use an ISO 8601 `date` when only date selection is enabled, a `time` when only time selection is enabled, or a `date-time` when date and time are both enabled. The boundary is inclusive and should not be earlier than `min`.

label.description: The text label for the input field.
